name: Brunch Electronik Porto
description: Dance from day to night at one of the city's most beloved electronic music events. Set in the sprawling green of Parque da Cidade, this edition brings a top-tier lineup of DJs for an unforgettable open-air party.
longDescription:
Brunch Electronik Porto is an established electronic music event series, known for its daytime to evening format. This edition, held on August 29, 2026, continues the series' tradition of presenting a curated selection of electronic music artists. The event is part of a broader initiative to bring international and local DJ talent to outdoor settings within the city.

Attendees can expect an open-air party atmosphere, extending from afternoon into the evening. The event takes place within Parque da Cidade, Porto's expansive urban park, providing a natural backdrop for the music. The audience typically consists of electronic music enthusiasts and those seeking a festive outdoor gathering.

This is a ticketed event. Information regarding ticket availability and purchase will be released closer to the date. Parque da Cidade is accessible by public transport, with several bus routes serving the park. Specific bus stops and routes can be identified via local transport apps.
